questions.stem: 当 \(x \to 0^{+}\) 时, 下列无穷小量中, 最高阶的是

solution.analysis_md:
当 \(x \to 0^{+}\) 时，
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2}} \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {t ^ {2}} + 1\right) \mathrm{d} t \sim \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2}} 2 \mathrm{d} t = 2 x ^ {2},
\]
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {x} \ln (1 + \sqrt {t ^ {3}}) \mathrm{d} t \sim \int_ {0} ^ {x} t ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {2}{5} x ^ {\frac {5}{2}},
\]
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {\sin x} \cos t ^ {2} \mathrm{d} t \sim \int_ {0} ^ {\sin x} 1 \mathrm{d} t = \sin x \sim x,
\]
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {1 - \cos x} \sqrt {\arcsin^ {3} t} \mathrm{d} t \sim \int_ {0} ^ {1 - \cos x} t ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {2}{5} (1 - \cos x) ^ {\frac {5}{2}} \sim \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2 0} x ^ {5}.
\]

questions.stem: 若微分方程 \( y'' + ay' + by = 0 \) 的解在 \((- \infty, +\infty)\) 上必为周期函数, 则

solution.analysis_md: 若该微分方程的解必有周期性, 则解的形式只能为 \( y = A \cos \beta x + B \sin \beta x \), 故对应的特征方程的根为 \( r_{1,2} = \pm \beta \mathrm{i} \), 此时, 特征方程为 \( r^2 + \beta^2 = 0 \). 故微分方程 \( y'' + ay' + by = 0 \) 中的系数 \( a, b \) 需满足: \( a = 0, b = \beta^2 > 0 \).

questions.stem: \(\int_{\frac{1}{4}}^{\frac{1}{2}} dy \int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{\sqrt{y}} e^{\frac{y}{x}} dx + \int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1} dy \int_{y}^{\sqrt{y}} e^{\frac{y}{x}} dx =\)

solution.analysis_md:
积分区域如图所示.交换积分次序,可得
\[
\begin{array}{l} \text {原式} = \int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {x} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {1} (\mathrm{ex} - x \mathrm{e} ^ {x}) \mathrm{d} x \\ = \left[ \frac {\mathrm{e}}{2} x ^ {2} - (x - 1) \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \right] _ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {1} = \frac {3}{8} \mathrm{e} - \frac {\sqrt {\mathrm{e}}}{2}. \\ \end{array}
\]
![](/uploads/books/4d65d97bf8e05fe7e8759c2b492306f15f74404d07f3cb5c93bef2d297d31631.jpg)

将 \(\arcsin x, \frac{1}{1 + ax^2}\) 在 \(x = 0\) 处泰勒展开, 得
\[
f (x) = \left(x + \frac {1}{6} x ^ {3} + \dots\right) - x \left(1 - a x ^ {2} + \dots\right) = \left(\frac {1}{6} + a\right) x ^ {3} + \dots ,
\]
由泰勒级数展开的唯一性,有  \( \frac{1}{6} + a = \frac{f''(0)}{3!} \) , 即  \( \frac{1}{6} + a = \frac{1}{3} \) , 故  \( a = \frac{1}{6} \) .

questions.stem: 设向量 \(\beta\) 可由向量组 \(\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}, \alpha_{4}\) 线性表示, 但不可由向量组 \((I): \alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}\) 线性表示, 记向量组 \((II): \alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}, \beta\), 则

options.A: \(\alpha_{4}\) 不可由向量组 \((I)\) 线性表示, 也不可由向量组 \((II)\) 线性表示.
options.B: \(\alpha_{4}\) 不可由向量组 \((I)\) 线性表示, 但可由向量组 \((II)\) 线性表示.
options.C: \(\alpha_{4}\) 可由向量组 \((I)\) 线性表示, 也可由向量组 \((II)\) 线性表示.
options.D: \(\alpha_{4}\) 可由向量组 \((I)\) 线性表示, 但不可由向量组 \((II)\) 线性表示.

solution.analysis_md:
先判别 \(\alpha_{4}\) 可否由向量组(Ⅱ)线性表示.
因为 \(\beta\) 可由向量组 \(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{4}\) 线性表示，则存在一组实数 \(k_{1},k_{2},k_{3},k_{4}\) ，使得
\[
\boldsymbol {\beta} = k _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + k _ {3} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} + k _ {4} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {4}. \tag {①}
\]
若 \(k_{4} = 0\) ，则 \(\pmb{\beta}\) 可由向量组（I）线性表示，与已知矛盾，故 \(k_{4}\neq 0\) .从而有
\[
\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {4} = \frac {1}{k _ {4}} (\boldsymbol {\beta} - k _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} - k _ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} - k _ {3} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}),
\]
即  \( \alpha_{4} \)  可由向量组(Ⅱ)线性表示.
再判别  \( \alpha_{4} \)  可否由向量组(Ⅰ)线性表示.
如果  \( \alpha_{4} \)  可由向量组(Ⅰ)线性表示, 则存在一组实数  \( l_{1}, l_{2}, l_{3} \) , 使得
\[
\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {4} = l _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + l _ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + l _ {3} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}. \tag {②}
\]
将②式代入①式, 得
\[
\boldsymbol {\beta} = \left(k _ {1} + k _ {4} l _ {1}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + \left(k _ {2} + k _ {4} l _ {2}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + \left(k _ {3} + k _ {4} l _ {3}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}.
\]
这表示 \(\beta\) 可由向量组(I)线性表示, 与已知矛盾, 所以 \(\alpha_{4}\) 不可由向量组(I)线性表示.

questions.stem: 设 \(A\) 为 \(n\) 阶矩阵, \(A^{*}\) 是 \(A\) 的伴随矩阵, 齐次线性方程组 \(Ax = 0\) 有两个线性无关的解, 则

options.C: \(Ax = 0\) 与 \(A^{*}x = 0\) 没有非零公共解.
options.D: \(Ax = 0\) 与 \(A^{*}x = 0\) 仅有两个非零公共解.

solution.analysis_md:
因为齐次线性方程组 Ax = 0 有两个线性无关的解向量, 所以方程组 Ax = 0 的基础解系所含向量个数  \( n - r(A) \geqslant 2 \) . 于是,  \( r(A) \leqslant n - 2 \) , 由此得  \( A^{*} = O \) , 可知任意 n 维列向量均是方程组  \( A^{*}x = 0 \)  的解. 因此, 方程组 Ax = 0 的解均是  \( A^{*}x = 0 \)  的解, 选项 B 正确. 选项 A 显然不正确.
对于选项C, D, 由于方程组 \(Ax = 0\) 的基础解系至少含有两个解, 故 \(Ax = 0\) 有无穷多个非零解, 与 \(A^{*}x = 0\) 也有无穷多个非零公共解. 显然选项C, D均不正确.

questions.stem: 设 \(A\) 是 3 阶矩阵, 向量 \(\alpha_{1} = (1,2,0)^{T}, \alpha_{2} = (1,0,1)^{T}, \beta = (-1,2,-2)^{T}\). 已知 \(\lambda = 2\) 是矩阵 \(A\) 的特征值, \(\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}\) 是矩阵 \(A\) 的属于 \(\lambda = 2\) 的特征向量, 则 \(A(\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \beta) =\)

solution.analysis_md:
将向量 \(\beta\) 表示为 \(\alpha_{1}\), \(\alpha_{2}\) 的线性组合形式. 由于
\[
(\alpha_ {1}, \alpha_ {2}, \beta) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 1 & - 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & - 2 \end{array} \right) \to \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & - 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{array} \right),
\]
所以 \(\beta = \alpha_{1} - 2\alpha_{2}\). 因为 \(\lambda = 2\) 是矩阵 \(A\) 的特征值, \(\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}\) 是矩阵 \(A\) 的属于 \(\lambda = 2\) 的特征向
量, 故向量  \( \beta \)  也是矩阵 A 的属于  \( \lambda = 2 \)  的特征向量. 则
\[
A (\alpha_ {1}, \alpha_ {2}, \boldsymbol {\beta}) = (2 \alpha_ {1}, 2 \alpha_ {2}, 2 \boldsymbol {\beta}) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 2 & - 2 \\ 4 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 2 & - 4 \end{array} \right).
\]

questions.stem:
设总体 \(X\) 的概率分布如下.
X-101
P\( \frac{1}{4} \)\( \frac{1}{2} \)\( \frac{1}{4} \)
从总体 \(X\) 中抽取 \(n\) 个简单随机样本, \(N_{1}\) 表示 \(n\) 个样本中取到-1的个数, \(N_{2}\) 表示 \(n\) 个样本中取到0的 个数, \( N_{3} \) 表示n个样本中取到1的个数,则 \( N_{1} \) 与 \( N_{2} \) 的相关系数为

solution.analysis_md:
由题意可知 \(N_{1} \sim B\left(n, \frac{1}{4}\right)\), \(N_{2} \sim B\left(n, \frac{1}{2}\right)\), \(N_{3} \sim B\left(n, \frac{1}{4}\right)\).
由 \(N_{1} + N_{2} + N_{3} = n\) ，即 \(N_{1} + N_{2} = n - N_{3}\) ，可知 \(N_{1} + N_{2}\sim B\left(n,\frac{3}{4}\right)\)
\[
D \left(N _ {1}\right) = n \times \frac {1}{4} \times \frac {3}{4} = \frac {3 n}{1 6}, D \left(N _ {2}\right) = n \times \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {1}{2} = \frac {n}{4}, D \left(N _ {1} + N _ {2}\right) = n \times \frac {3}{4} \times \frac {1}{4} = \frac {3 n}{1 6}.
\]
又 \(D(N_{1} + N_{2}) = D(N_{1}) + D(N_{2}) + 2\mathrm{Cov}(N_{1},N_{2})\) ，得 \(\mathrm{Cov}(N_1,N_2) = -\frac{n}{8}\) .所以
\[
\rho_ {N _ {1} N _ {2}} = \frac {\operatorname{Cov} (N _ {1} , N _ {2})}{\sqrt {D (N _ {1})} \sqrt {D (N _ {2})}} = \frac {- \frac {n}{8}}{\sqrt {\frac {3 n}{1 6} \sqrt {\frac {n}{4}}}} = - \frac {\sqrt {3}}{3}.
\]

questions.stem: 设总体 \(X\) 服从参数为 1 的泊松分布, \(X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}\) 为来自总体 \(X\) 的简单随机样本. 记 \(v_{n}(1)\) 为 \(n\) 个观测值中不大于 1 的个数, 则当 \(n\) 充分大时, \(\frac{v_{n}(1)}{n}\) 依概率收敛于

solution.analysis_md:
依题意知， \( P\{X=k\}=\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-1}}{k!}(k=0,1,\cdots) \) ，则 \( P\{X\leqslant1\}=P\{X=0\}+P\{X=1\}=\frac{2}{\mathrm{e}} \)
又 \(\frac{\upsilon_n(1)}{n}\) 为事件 \(\{X\leqslant 1\}\) 在 \(n\) 次观测中出现的频率，当 \(n\) 充分大时，由伯努利大数定律，知
\[
\frac {\upsilon_ {n} (1)}{n} \xrightarrow {P} P \{X \leqslant 1 \} = \frac {2}{\mathrm{e}}.
\]

questions.stem: 设总体 \(X \sim U(0, \alpha), Y \sim U(\alpha, 2\alpha), \alpha > 0\) 为未知参数. \(X, Y\) 相互独立. 记 \(Z_{(a, b)} = aX + bY\), 则当 \(E(Z_{(a, b)}) = \alpha\), 且 \(D(Z_{(a, b)})\) 最小时, 有

solution.analysis_md:
依题意， \( E(Z_{(a,b)}) = aE(X) + bE(Y) = a \cdot \frac{\alpha}{2} + b \cdot \frac{3\alpha}{2} = \alpha \)，即
\[
a + 3 b = 2. \tag {*}
\]
又 \(D(Z_{(a,b)}) = a^2 D(X) + b^2 D(Y) = a^2\cdot \frac{\alpha^2}{12} +b^2\cdot \frac{\alpha^2}{12} = \frac{\alpha^2}{12}(a^2 +b^2),\)
且由 \((\ast)\) 式知 \(a = 2 - 3b\) ，故 \(D(Z_{(a,b)}) = \frac{\alpha^2}{12}\left[(2 - 3b)^2 + b^2\right] = \frac{\alpha^2}{6}(2 - 6b + 5b^2)\) .令
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} \left[ D (Z _ {(a , b)}) \right]}{\mathrm{d} b} = \frac {\alpha^ {2}}{6} (- 6 + 1 0 b) = 0,
\]
得 \(b = \frac{3}{5}\) ，则 \(a = \frac{1}{5}\)
二、填空题

questions.stem: \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\ln\frac{\sin x}{x}}{\int_0^{x^2}(1 + t)^t dt} =\)

solution.analysis_md: \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\ln\frac{\sin x}{x}}{\int_0^{x^2}(1 + t)^t\mathrm{d}t} = \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\frac{\sin x}{x} - 1}{\mathrm{e}x^2} = \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\sin x - x}{\mathrm{e}x^3} = -\frac{1}{6\mathrm{e}}.\)

questions.stem: 曲线 \( y = x \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{x + 1}} \) 的斜渐近线方程为 ____.

solution.analysis_md:
\(\lim_{x\to \infty}\frac{y}{x} = \lim_{x\to \infty}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{x + 1}} = 1,\)
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} (y - x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \left(x \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{x + 1}} - x\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} x \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{x + 1}} - 1\right) \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \frac {- x}{x + 1} = - 1, \\ \end{array}
\]
故斜渐近线方程为 \(y = x - 1\)

questions.stem: 微分方程 \((x - y - 1)\mathrm{d}x + (x + 4y - 1)\mathrm{d}y = 0\) 的通解为 ____.

solution.analysis_md:
将原方程写成 \(\frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}} = \frac{-(x - 1) + y}{(x - 1) + 4y}\)
令 \(X = x - 1\) ， \(Y = y\) ，则 \(\mathrm{dx} = \mathrm{dX}\) ， \(\mathrm{dy} = \mathrm{dY}\) ，原方程化为 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}Y}{\mathrm{d}X} = \frac{-X + Y}{X + 4Y}\) ，即
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} Y}{\mathrm{d} X} = \frac {\frac {Y}{X} - 1}{\frac {4 Y}{X} + 1},
\]
令 \(u = \frac{Y}{X}\) ，则有 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}Y}{\mathrm{d}X} = u + X\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}X}\) ，此时原方程化为 \(X\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}X} = \frac{-1 - 4u^2}{4u + 1}\) ，此为可分离变量的微
分方程, 即 \(\frac{4u + 1}{4u^2 + 1} \mathrm{d}u = -\frac{1}{X} \mathrm{d}X\), 解得 \(\ln \left[ X^2 (4u^2 + 1) \right] + \arctan 2u = C\).
将 \(u = \frac{Y}{X} = \frac{y}{x - 1}\) ， \(X = x - 1\) 代入，得方程的通解为 \(\ln \left[(x - 1)^2 +4y^2\right] + \arctan \frac{2y}{x - 1} = C\) ， \(C\) 为任意常数.

questions.stem: 已知方程组 \((I)\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x_{2} + ax_{3} = 0, \\ x_{1} + x_{2} + (a + 1)x_{3} = 0 \end{array} \right.\) 的解均是方程组 \((II)\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x_{1} + x_{2} + 2x_{3} = 0, \\ x_{1} + x_{2} + bx_{3} = 0 \end{array} \right.\) 的解, 但方程组 \((I)\) 与方程组 \((II)\) 不同解. 设矩阵 \(A\) 为方程组 \((I)\) 的系数矩阵, 矩阵 \(B\) 为方程组 \((II)\) 的系数矩阵, 则 \(B^{T}A =\) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
由题意, 得 \(A = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & 1 & a \\ 1 & 1 & a + 1 \end{pmatrix}\), \(B = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 & b \end{pmatrix}\), 可知 \(r(A) = 2\), 由 \(Ax = 0\) 的解均是 \(Bx = 0\) 的解, 可知 \(\binom{A}{B} x = 0\) 与 \(Ax = 0\) 同解且 \(r(A) \geqslant r(B)\), 进而可得 \(r\binom{A}{B} = r(A) = 2\), 又 \(Ax = 0\) 与 \(Bx = 0\) 不同解, 故 \(r(B) = 1\), 得 \(b = 2\).
又 \(\binom{A}{B} = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & 1 & a \\ 1 & 1 & a + 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \end{pmatrix} \to \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & a \\ 0 & 0 & a - 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix}\), 且 \(r\binom{A}{B} = 2\), 故 \(a = 1\).
于是  \( B^{T}A=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&1\\2&2\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}0&1&1\\1&1&2\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}1&2&3\\1&2&3\\2&4&6\end{pmatrix}. \)

questions.stem: 设总体 \(X\) 的概率密度 \(f(x) = \begin{cases} \mu x, & 0 \leqslant x < 1, \\ \theta x, & 1 \leqslant x \leqslant 2, \\ 0, & \text{其他}, \end{cases}\) \(\mu, \theta\) 为未知参数且 \(\mu > 0, \theta > 0, Y = \mathrm{e}^{X}, X\) 的样本观测值为 0.1, 0.9, 1.2, 1.2, 则 \(P\{Y < 4\}\) 的最大似然估计值为 ____.

solution.analysis_md:
由归一性 \(\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x)\mathrm{d}x = 1\) ，得
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {1} \mu x \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {1} ^ {2} \theta x \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \mu + \frac {3}{2} \theta = 1, \text {即} \mu = 2 - 3 \theta .
\]
根据 \(X\) 的样本观测值, 知似然函数为
\[
L = 0. 1 \mu \cdot 0. 9 \mu (1. 2 \theta) ^ {2} = 0. 1 2 9 6 \mu^ {2} \theta^ {2} = 0. 1 2 9 6 (2 - 3 \theta) ^ {2} \theta^ {2},
\]
从而有
\[
\ln L = \ln 0. 1 2 9 6 + 2 \ln (2 - 3 \theta) + 2 \ln \theta ,
\]
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} (\ln L)}{\mathrm{d} \theta} = \frac {- 6}{2 - 3 \theta} + \frac {2}{\theta} \stackrel {\text {令}} {=} 0,
\]
得 \(\theta\) 的最大似然估计值为 \(\hat{\theta} = \frac{1}{3}\)，且
\[
P \{Y <   4 \} = P \left\{\mathrm{e} ^ {X} <   4 \right\} = P \{X <   2 \ln 2 \}
\]
\[
= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mu x \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {1} ^ {2 \ln 2} \theta x \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} (2 - 3 \theta) + \left(2 \ln^ {2} 2 - \frac {1}{2}\right) \theta
\]
\[
= 1 + (2 \ln^ {2} 2 - 2) \theta .
\]
根据最大似然估计的不变性原理, 知  \( P\{Y<4\} \)  的最大似然估计值为
\[
1 + \left(2 \ln^ {2} 2 - 2\right) \hat {\theta} = 1 + \frac {1}{3} \left(2 \ln^ {2} 2 - 2\right) = \frac {1}{3} + \frac {2}{3} \ln^ {2} 2.
\]
三、解答题

questions.stem: 计算 \(\int \frac{x^2 + 2}{(x^2 + x + 1)^2} \mathrm{d}x.\)

solution.analysis_md:
法一 \(\int \frac{x^2 + 2}{(x^2 + x + 1)^2} \mathrm{d}x = \int \frac{x^2 + 2}{\left[\left(x + \frac{1}{2}\right)^2 + \frac{3}{4}\right]^2} \mathrm{d}x.\)
令 \(x + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\tan t\) ，则
原式 \(= \int \frac{\frac{3}{4}\tan^2t - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\tan t + \frac{1}{4} + 2}{\frac{9}{16}\sec^4t}\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sec^2 t\mathrm{d}t\) ……3分
\[
= \frac {1 6}{9} \cdot \frac {\sqrt {3}}{2} \cdot \frac {3}{4} \int \frac {\tan^ {2} t - \frac {2}{\sqrt {3}} \tan t + 3}{\sec^ {2} t} \mathrm{d} t
\]
\[
= \frac {2 \sqrt {3}}{3} \int \left(\sin^ {2} t - \frac {2}{\sqrt {3}} \sin t \cdot \cos t + 3 \cos^ {2} t\right) d t
\]
\[
= \frac {2 \sqrt {3}}{3} \int \left(1 + 2 \cos^ {2} t - \frac {2}{\sqrt {3}} \sin t \cos t\right) d t \quad \dots \dots 5 \text {分}
\]
\[
= \frac {2 \sqrt {3}}{3} \left(2 t + \frac {\sin 2 t}{2} - \frac {\sin^ {2} t}{\sqrt {3}}\right) + C _ {0}. \quad \dots \dots 7 \text {分}
\]
由 \(x + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\tan t\) 可得 \(\tan t = \frac{2x + 1}{\sqrt{3}}\) ，如图所示，则
![](/uploads/books/8b585036335e38c5260eed57959a17b0a20b5bb820f041c9cb4d830e67561868.jpg)
\(\sin t = \frac{x + \frac{1}{2}}{\sqrt{x^2 + x + 1}}, \cos t = \frac{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}{\sqrt{x^2 + x + 1}}\)，代入得
原式 \(= \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}\arctan \frac{2x + 1}{\sqrt{3}} +\frac{-\frac{2}{3}x^2 + \frac{1}{3}x + \frac{1}{3}}{x^2 + x + 1} +C_0\)
\(= \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}\arctan \frac{2x + 1}{\sqrt{3}} +\frac{x + 1}{x^2 + x + 1} +C(C\) 为任意常数）． ……10分
法二 \(\int \frac{x^2 + 2}{(x^2 + x + 1)^2} \mathrm{d}x = \int \left[\frac{1}{x^2 + x + 1} - \frac{x - 1}{(x^2 + x + 1)^2}\right] \mathrm{d}x\)
\[
= \int \frac {1}{x ^ {2} + x + 1} \mathrm{d} x - \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (x ^ {2} + x + 1)}{(x ^ {2} + x + 1) ^ {2}} + \frac {3}{2} \int \frac {1}{(x ^ {2} + x + 1) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x. \dots \dots 4 \text {分}
\]
由 \(\int \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{(x^2 + a^2)^2} = \frac{x}{2a^2(x^2 + a^2)} + \frac{1}{2a^2}\int \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^2 + a^2}\)，可知
\[
\int \frac {1}{(x ^ {2} + x + 1) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {2}{3} \cdot \frac {x + \frac {1}{2}}{x ^ {2} + x + 1} + \frac {2}{3} \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x ^ {2} + x + 1},
\]
由此得
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int \frac {1}{x ^ {2} + x + 1} \mathrm{d} x + \frac {3}{2} \int \frac {1}{(x ^ {2} + x + 1) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {x + \frac {1}{2}}{x ^ {2} + x + 1} + 2 \int \frac {1}{x ^ {2} + x + 1} \mathrm{d} x \\ = \frac {2 x + 1}{2 (x ^ {2} + x + 1)} + \frac {4}{\sqrt {3}} \arctan \frac {2 x + 1}{\sqrt {3}} + C _ {1}, \quad \dots \dots 7 \text {分} \\ \end{array}
\]
因此有
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int \frac {x ^ {2} + 2}{(x ^ {2} + x + 1) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2 (x ^ {2} + x + 1)} + \frac {2 x + 1}{2 (x ^ {2} + x + 1)} + \frac {4}{\sqrt {3}} \arctan \frac {2 x + 1}{\sqrt {3}} + C \\ = \frac {x + 1}{x ^ {2} + x + 1} + \frac {4}{\sqrt {3}} \arctan \frac {2 x + 1}{\sqrt {3}} + C (C \text {为任意常数}). \quad \dots \dots 1 0 \text {分} \\ \end{array}
\]

questions.stem: 设曲面 \(z = f(x,y)\) 过点 \((0,0,2)\), 且 \(\Delta z\) 关于 \(x\) 的偏增量 \(\Delta_x z = -2xe^{-y} \cdot \Delta x + o(\Delta x), \Delta z\) 关于 \(y\) 的偏增量 \(\Delta_y z = e^{-y}(x^2 - y - 1) \cdot \Delta y + o(\Delta y)\), 求 \(z = f(x,y)\) 的表达式及 \(z\) 的极值.

solution.analysis_md:
由题设可知 \( f_{x}^{\prime}(x, y) = -2x\mathrm{e}^{-y} \), \( f_{y}^{\prime}(x, y) = \mathrm{e}^{-y}(x^{2} - y - 1) \), \( f(0, 0) = 2 \).
等式 \( f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=-2x\mathrm{e}^{-y} \) 两边同时对x积分,得
\[
f (x, y) = - x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- y} + \varphi (y), \quad \dots \dots 2 \text {分}
\]
则 \(f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y) = x^{2}\mathrm{e}^{-y} + \varphi^{\prime}(y)\) ， ……4分
由已知 \( f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=\mathrm{e}^{-y}(x^{2}-y-1) \) ，可得 \( \varphi^{\prime}(y)=-(y+1)\mathrm{e}^{-y} \) .
\(\varphi^{\prime}(y)\) 对 \(y\) 积分，得 \(\varphi (y) = (y + 2)\mathrm{e}^{-y} + C\) ，则
\[
f (x, y) = - x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- y} + (y + 2) \mathrm{e} ^ {- y} + C. \quad \dots \dots 5 \text {分}
\]
由 \( f(0,0)=2 \) 可得C=0，故 \( z=f(x,y)=(-x^{2}+y+2)\mathrm{e}^{-y} \) . ……6分
令 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} f_x'(x, y) = -2x\mathrm{e}^{-y} = 0, \\ f_y'(x, y) = (x^2 - y - 1)\mathrm{e}^{-y} = 0, \end{array} \right.\) 得 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = 0, \\ y = -1. \end{array} \right.\) ……8分
又 \(f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(x,y) = -2\mathrm{e}^{-y},f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(x,y) = 2x\mathrm{e}^{-y},f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(x,y) = (-x^{2} + y)\mathrm{e}^{-y},\)
则在点 \((0, -1)\) 处，\(A = f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(0, -1) = -2\mathrm{e}\)，\(B = f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(0, -1) = 0\)，\(C = f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(0, -1) = -\mathrm{e}\)，可得 \(AC - B^2 > 0\)，且 \(A < 0\)。……11分
故 \(z = f(x,y)\) 在 \((0, - 1)\) 处取得极大值，极大值为 \(f(0, - 1) = \mathrm{e}\) 12分

questions.stem:
(1) 设  \( f(x) \)  在  \( [a, b] \)  上具有二阶连续导数，证明存在  \( \xi \in (a, b) \) ，使得
\[
\int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) (b - a) + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi)}{2 4} (b - a) ^ {3};
\]
(2) 设  \( g(x) \)  在  \( [-1,1] \)  上具有三阶连续导数，且  \( g(-1)=g(1), g'(0)=0 \) ，证明存在  \( \eta\in(-1,1) \) ，使得  \( g''(\eta)=0 \) .

solution.analysis_md:
(1) 由题可知, \(f(x)\) 在 \([a, b]\) 上具有二阶连续导数, 故
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {a} ^ {\frac {a + b}{2}} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {a} ^ {\frac {a + b}{2}} f (x) \mathrm{d} (x - a) = f (x) (x - a) \left| _ {a} ^ {\frac {a + b}{2}} - \int_ {a} ^ {\frac {a + b}{2}} (x - a) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \right. \\ = f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) \cdot \frac {b - a}{2} - f ^ {\prime} (x) \cdot \frac {(x - a) ^ {2}}{2} \Bigg | _ {a} ^ {\frac {a + b}{2}} + \int_ {a} ^ {\frac {a + b}{2}} f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) \frac {(x - a) ^ {2}}{2} d x \\ = f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) \cdot \frac {b - a}{2} - f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) \cdot \frac {(b - a) ^ {2}}{8} + f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) \cdot \frac {(b - a) ^ {3}}{4 8}, \tag {①} \\ \end{array}
\]
……3分
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {\frac {a + b}{2}} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {\frac {a + b}{2}} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} (x - b) = f (x) (x - b) \Big | _ {\frac {a + b}{2}} ^ {b} - \int_ {\frac {a + b}{2}} ^ {b} (x - b) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \\ = f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) \cdot \frac {b - a}{2} - f ^ {\prime} (x) \cdot \frac {(x - b) ^ {2}}{2} \Bigg | _ {\frac {a + b}{2}} ^ {b} + \int_ {\frac {a + b}{2}} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) \frac {(x - b) ^ {2}}{2} d x \\ = f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) \cdot \frac {b - a}{2} + f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) \cdot \frac {(b - a) ^ {2}}{8} + f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2}) \cdot \frac {(b - a) ^ {3}}{4 8}, \tag {②} \\ \end{array}
\]
其中 \(\xi_{1}\) 介于 \(a\) 与 \(\frac{a + b}{2}\) 之间，\(\xi_{2}\) 介于 \(\frac{a + b}{2}\) 与 \(b\) 之间. ……6分
①式与②式相加, 得
\[
\int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) (b - a) + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {1}) + f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi_ {2})}{2} \cdot \frac {(b - a) ^ {3}}{2 4}
\]
\[
\frac {\text {导函数的}}{\text {介值性}} f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) (b - a) + f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi) \frac {(b - a) ^ {3}}{2 4},
\]
其中 \(\xi \in (\xi_1, \xi_2) \subset (a, b)\).
……8分
(2)由题可知, \(g'(x)\) 在 \([-1,1]\) 上具有二阶连续导数, 由(1)知, 存在 \(\eta \in (-1,1)\), 使
\[
\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x = g ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {- 1 + 1}{2}\right) (1 + 1) + \frac {g ^ {\prime \prime} (\eta)}{2 4} (1 + 1) ^ {3},
\]
即 \(g(1) - g(-1) = 2g'(0) + \frac{g''(\eta)}{3}\)，又因为 \(g(-1) = g(1), g'(0) = 0\)，故 \(g''(\eta) = 0\)。……12分

questions.stem: 设 \(D = \{(x, y) \mid x^2 + y^2 \leqslant 2x + 2y\}\), 求二重积分 \(\iint_{D} (x^2 + x + y) d\sigma\).

solution.analysis_md:
法一 令 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = 1 + r\cos \theta, \\ y = 1 + r\sin \theta, \end{array} \right.\) 则 \(D = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant 2\pi, 0 \leqslant r \leqslant \sqrt{2}\right\}\), ……2分
故 \(\iint_{D} (x^{2} + x + y) \mathrm{d}\sigma = \int_{0}^{2\pi} \mathrm{d}\theta \int_{0}^{\sqrt{2}} \left[ (1 + r \cos \theta)^{2} + 1 + r \cos \theta + 1 + r \sin \theta \right] r \mathrm{d}r\) ……5分
\[
= \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {2}} \left[ 3 r + r ^ {2} (3 \cos \theta + \sin \theta) + r ^ {3} \cos^ {2} \theta \right] \mathrm{d} r
\]
\[
= \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \left[ 3 + \frac {2 \sqrt {2}}{3} (3 \cos \theta + \sin \theta) + \cos^ {2} \theta \right] d \theta \quad \dots \dots 9 \text {分}
\]
\[
= 7 \pi . \quad \dots \dots 1 2 \text {分}
\]
法二 将 \(D\) 改写成 \(D = \left\{(x, y) \mid (x - 1)^2 + (y - 1)^2 \leqslant (\sqrt{2})^2\right\}\), 令 \(u = x - 1\), \(v = y - 1\), 则
\[
\iint_ {D} (x ^ {2} + x + y) \mathrm{d} \sigma = \iint_ {u ^ {2} + v ^ {2} \leqslant 2} \left[ (u + 1) ^ {2} + u + 1 + v + 1 \right] \mathrm{d} \sigma^ {\prime} \quad \dots \dots 4 \text {分}
\]
\[
= \iint_ {u ^ {2} + v ^ {2} \leqslant 2} (u ^ {2} + 3 u + v + 3) \mathrm{d} \sigma^ {\prime} = \iint_ {u ^ {2} + v ^ {2} \leqslant 2} u ^ {2} \mathrm{d} \sigma^ {\prime} + 3 \cdot 2 \pi \quad \dots \dots 6 \text {分}
\]
\[
= 6 \pi + \frac {1}{2} \iint_ {u ^ {2} + v ^ {2} \leqslant 2} (u ^ {2} + v ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} \sigma^ {\prime} = 6 \pi + \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {2}} r ^ {2} \cdot r \mathrm{d} r \dots \dots 9 \text {分}
\]
\[
= 6 \pi + \pi
\]
\[
= 7 \pi . \quad \dots \dots 1 2 \text {分}
\]

(1) \( f(x_{1}, x_{2}, x_{3}) \) 对应的二次型矩阵为 \( A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & 4 & 6 \\ 3 & 6 & 9 \end{pmatrix} \)，因为
\[
\left| \lambda \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A} \right| = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda - 1 & - 2 & - 3 \\ - 2 & \lambda - 4 & - 6 \\ - 3 & - 6 & \lambda - 9 \end{array} \right| = \lambda^ {2} (\lambda - 1 4),
\]
所以 A 的特征值为  \( \lambda_{1}=14 \) ， \( \lambda_{2}=\lambda_{3}=0 \) 。
……3分
当 \(\lambda_{1} = 14\) 时，解方程组 \((14E - A)x = 0\) ，得特征向量 \(\xi_{1} = \begin{pmatrix} 1\\ 2\\ 3 \end{pmatrix}\) ，单位化得 \(\eta_{1} = \begin{pmatrix} \frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}\\ \frac{2}{\sqrt{14}}\\ \frac{3}{\sqrt{14}} \end{pmatrix}\)
……5分
当 \(\lambda_{2} = \lambda_{3} = 0\) 时，解方程组 \((0E - A)x = 0\) ，得两个线性无关的特征向量 \(\xi_{2} = \begin{pmatrix} -2\\ 1\\ 0 \end{pmatrix}\)
\(\xi_{3} = \begin{pmatrix} -3\\ 0\\ 1 \end{pmatrix}\) ，正交单位化得 \(\pmb{\eta}_{2} = \begin{pmatrix} -\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\\ 0 \end{pmatrix},\pmb{\eta}_{3} = \begin{pmatrix} -\frac{3}{\sqrt{70}}\\ -\frac{6}{\sqrt{70}}\\ \frac{5}{\sqrt{70}} \end{pmatrix}.\) ……7分
令  \( \boldsymbol{Q}=(\boldsymbol{\eta}_{1},\boldsymbol{\eta}_{2},\boldsymbol{\eta}_{3})=\begin{pmatrix}\frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}&-\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}&-\frac{3}{\sqrt{70}}\\\frac{2}{\sqrt{14}}&\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}&-\frac{6}{\sqrt{70}}\\\frac{3}{\sqrt{14}}&0&\frac{5}{\sqrt{70}}\end{pmatrix} \) ，则 Q 为正交矩阵，且
\[
\boldsymbol {Q} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {Q} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 4 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{array} \right).
\]
故在正交变换 \(x = Qy\) 下，\(f(x_{1}, x_{2}, x_{3})\) 可化为标准形 \(14y_{1}^{2}\)。……8分
(2) 由 \( f(x_{1}, x_{2}, x_{3}) = 0 \) 及(1)，得 \( 14y_{1}^{2} = 0 \)，故 \( y_{1} = 0 \). 又 \( y = Q^{\mathrm{T}}x \)，从而 \( f(x_{1}, x_{2}, x_{3}) = 0 \) 的解
满足 \(x_{1} + 2x_{2} + 3x_{3} = 0\)
……10分
故 \(\begin{pmatrix} x_1 \\ x_2 \\ x_3 \end{pmatrix} = k_1 \begin{pmatrix} -2 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix} + k_2 \begin{pmatrix} -3 \\ 0 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}\), 其中 \(k_1, k_2\) 为任意常数.
……12分

questions.stem:
设随机变量 \( (X,Y) \) 的概率密度为 \( f(x,y)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&a\left(x^{2}+\frac{xy}{2}\right),&0<x<1,0<y<2,\\ &0,& 其他.\end{aligned}\right. \)
(1) 求 a 的值;
(2) \(X, Y\) 是否相互独立，说明理由；
(3) 计算  \( P\left\{Y>1 \mid X=\frac{1}{2}\right\} \) .

solution.analysis_md:
(1) \(1 = \int_{\mathbb{R}} f(x, y) \mathrm{d}x \mathrm{d}y = a \int_{0}^{1} \mathrm{d}x \int_{0}^{2} \left( x^{2} + \frac{xy}{2} \right) \mathrm{d}y = a \int_{0}^{1} (2x^{2} + x) \mathrm{d}x = \frac{7}{6} a\)，可得 \(a = \frac{6}{7}\).
……2分
(2) 当 \(0 < x < 1\) 时, \(f_{X}(x) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} f(x, y) \mathrm{d}y = \frac{6}{7} \int_{0}^{2} \left( x^{2} + \frac{xy}{2} \right) \mathrm{d}y = \frac{6}{7} (2x^{2} + x)\);
当 \(x \leqslant 0\) 或 \(x \geqslant 1\) 时，\(f_{X}(x) = 0\)。
故 \( f_{X}(x)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&\frac{6}{7}(2x^{2}+x),&0<x<1,\\ &0,& 其他.\end{aligned}\right. \)
……5分
当 \(0 < y < 2\) 时，\(f_{Y}(y) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} f(x, y) \mathrm{d}x = \frac{6}{7} \int_{0}^{1} \left( x^{2} + \frac{xy}{2} \right) \mathrm{d}x = \frac{2}{7} + \frac{3}{14} y\);
当 \(y \leqslant 0\) 或 \(y \geqslant 2\) 时，\(f_{Y}(y) = 0\)。
故 \( f_{Y}(y)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&\frac{2}{7}+\frac{3}{14}y,&0<y<2,\\ &0,& 其他.\end{aligned}\right. \)
……8分
因为 \( f(x,y)\neq f_{X}(x)f_{Y}(y) \) ，所以X与Y不相互独立.
……9分
(3) 当 \(y \leqslant 0\) 或 \(y \geqslant 2\) 时, \(f_{Y|X}\left(y \mid x = \frac{1}{2}\right) = 0\), 当 \(0 < y < 2\) 时,
\[
f _ {Y \mid X} \left(y \mid x = \frac {1}{2}\right) = \frac {f \left(\frac {1}{2} , y\right)}{f _ {X} \left(\frac {1}{2}\right)} = \frac {\frac {3}{1 4} (1 + y)}{\frac {6}{7}} = \frac {1 + y}{4},
\]
……11分
于是， \(P\left\{Y > 1\mid X = \frac{1}{2}\right\} = \int_{1}^{2}\frac{1 + y}{4}\mathrm{d}y = \frac{5}{8}.\)
……12分
【注】由于 \(P\left\{X = \frac{1}{2}\right\} = 0\) ，故不能用条件概率公式 \(P\left\{Y > 1 \mid X = \frac{1}{2}\right\} = \frac{P\left\{Y > 1, X = \frac{1}{2}\right\}}{P\left\{X = \frac{1}{2}\right\}}.\)
